title: EviQE: Evidence Selection for LLM-Based Query Expansion
abstract: arXiv:2609.14875v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: LLM-based query expansion increasingly conditions reformulation on documents retrieved from the target corpus, yet most work focuses on how to generate expansions rather than which documents the model should read. We propose EviQE, which aggregates documents retrieved by multiple reformulators, selects a compact evidence set, and uses it for one grounded expansion step. This separates evidence selection from generation and treats reformulators as complementary retrieval perspectives. Across three TREC DL and five BEIR benchmarks, reformulators frequently retrieve distinct relevant documents, so pooled candidates provide higher relevant-document coverage than any individual source. The strongest gains come from relevance-based evidence selection: LLM-Score consistently outperforms direct reformulation, cold-start expansion, and single-source seeded expansion. translated_title: EviQE：面向基于大语言模型查询扩展的证据选择
translated_abstract: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的查询扩展越来越多地依赖从目标语料库检索到的文档来指导查询改写，然而大多数工作关注的是如何生成扩展，而非模型应该阅读哪些文档。我们提出了EviQE，该方法聚合由多个改写器检索到的文档，从中选择一个紧凑的证据集，并将其用于一次基于证据的扩展步骤。这将证据选择与生成分离开来，并将各个改写器视为互补的检索视角。在三个TREC DL和五个BEIR基准测试上，不同改写器经常检索到不同的相关文档，因此汇总的候选集比任何单一来源都能提供更高的相关文档覆盖率。最大的增益来自基于相关性的证据选择：LLM-Score持续优于直接改写、冷启动扩展和单源种子扩展。在具备强条件证据的情况下，额外的检索-生成轮次几乎不再带来收益。
tldr: 提出EviQE框架，通过聚合多个改写器的检索结果并进行基于相关性的证据选择（LLM-Score），将证据选择与查询生成分离，显著提升了基于LLM的查询扩展效果。
en_tdlr: Proposes EviQE, which aggregates documents from multiple reformulators and applies relevance-based evidence selection (LLM-Score) to decouple evidence selection from generation, significantly improving LLM-based query expansion.
